text: @zhujiuyi/dsh-balance 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页端的余额与额度插件。它根据当前会话的模型路由查询供应商 API 余额或订阅额度，并在输入框下方显示读数，点开可查看供应商、计费方式、接口地址、读取时间和额度窗口。插件提供 balance_check 工具供 agent 查询，也可用 balance_set_endpoint 设置路由的自定义查询接口；网页设置表单支持调整默认路由和自动刷新策略。适合需要在 DSH 会话中查看模型额度、减少切换供应商控制台的用户。运行需要在 DSH 配置相应供应商凭据。

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance checks API balances and subscription quotas for the active DSH model route. It displays a composer readout and detail panel. Agents can query with balance_check or set a custom endpoint with balance_set_endpoint. Configure provider credentials in DSH.
想直接在 DSH 里看当前模型还剩多少 API 余额。
有没有办法查看模型订阅额度还剩多少？
让 DSH 在输入框旁显示当前模型的余额读数。
我想点开一个面板看额度窗口和最近查询时间。
能不能让 agent 帮我查询当前供应商的余额？
供应商换了余额接口，怎么给某个模型路由填自定义地址？
How can I see the remaining balance for the model route I am using in DSH?
Can I check my provider's subscription quota from the chat interface?
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance 的功能「当前路由余额查询」：按会话实际使用的模型路由读取供应商 API 余额或订阅余量。agent 可调用 balance_check，也可指定路由并要求强制刷新，结果包含额度和查询状态。
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance 的功能「输入框余额读数」：网页客户端在会话输入框下方显示余额或额度状态，点击读数可展开详情，展示供应商、计费方式和额度信息。
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance 的功能「自定义余额接口」：当内置目录无法匹配路由或供应商接口变更时，可通过 balance_set_endpoint 保存该路由的接口模板；模板支持 {origin} 和 {base}。
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance 的功能「额度自动刷新」：插件根据配置的刷新开关、最小间隔、数据过期时长和失败冷却控制供应商查询；用户也能在界面手动刷新读数。
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance 使用时需要在 DSH 凭据库配置对应供应商的凭据；查询通过供应商接口获取余额或额度，缺少凭据时会返回明确提示。
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Introduction：[中文](README.zh-CN.md) | **English**

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Balance & Quota · dsh-balance-meter：> A small plugin for DeepSeek Harness: **it tells you how much credit or quota is left for the model you're actually using.**

No control panels to open, no mental arithmetic, and no being fooled by a stale number — if it genuinely can't read your balance, it says why.

Click it to open the full panel:

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · What problem it solves：Running an agent on API credit or a subscription, two things bite:

1. **You run out mid-task** and only find out when it breaks.
2. **You juggle several dashboards** — DeepSeek, Kimi, Zhipu — and they don't even report the same thing: some give money, some give percentages.

This plugin gathers it into one place: **whichever provider your current session is using, it reads that provider's balance** and shows it the same way every time.

---
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · What it can read：Balances are **per provider**, not per model — every model under one provider shares the same pool.

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ✅ Supported: 9 built-in providers：| Provider | What it reads | Shown as |
|---|---|---|
| **DeepSeek** | account balance | money (`¥12.34`) |
| **OpenRouter** | key credit | money |
| **Moonshot / Kimi** | account balance | money |
| **SiliconFlow** | account balance | money |
| **智谱 GLM / Z.AI** | subscription quota | window percentages |
| **Kimi Coding** | subscription quota | window percentages |
| **MiniMax** | plan quota | window percentages |
| **OpenCode Go** | subscription quota | window percentages |
| **OpenDesign (AMR)** | wallet + Design Plan windows | money + percentages |

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ✅ Supported: 9 built-in providers："Window percentages" means the plugin lists each quota period separately — rolling / weekly / monthly — with its own bar and reset time. So you can tell whether the 5-hour window is nearly spent or the monthly total is running out.

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ⚠️ May work: common relay panels：If you use a **self-hosted relay** (New-API, Sub2API, CloseAI, claude-code-hub and similar), the plugin tries a set of conventional endpoints in order:

```
/api/usage/token/  →  /v1/dashboard/billing/subscription  →  /v1/usage
→  /api/v1/me/quota  →  /dashboard/billing/credit_grants
→  /api/v1/credits  →  /api/user/self
```

Whichever returns a readable figure first wins. **An endpoint you configure yourself is tried before all of them.**

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ⚠️ May work: common relay panels：> The mechanism (ordering, short-circuiting, unit calibration) is covered by tests, but **each preset's response shape was transcribed from public panel documentation and the author cannot verify them all against live servers**. So an unrecognised shape is reported as "reachable but unparseable" with the raw response attached — never guessed at.

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ❌ Not supported：| Situation | What happens |
|---|---|
| **The vendor has no public balance endpoint** | Says so plainly; invents nothing |
| **Route isn't in the catalog and no preset matched** | Reports "not catalogued" plus the last raw response |
| **No credential configured** | Names the variable you need to set |
| **Endpoint answered but the shape is unknown** | Reports "unparseable" with an excerpt (secrets masked) |

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ❌ Not supported："Not catalogued" means **this plugin doesn't recognise that provider yet** — it does not mean the vendor has no balance endpoint. Setting a custom endpoint via `balance_set_endpoint` usually fixes it.

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @zhujiuyi/dsh-balance
```

Then **restart DSH**. The readout appears on the stats row under the composer.

> Don't install `dsh-balance-meter` (no scope). That name belongs to an unrelated package on npm.

Prefer not to use npm? Install the tarball from a release instead — `/latest/` follows the newest one, so this command needs no editing:

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/zhujiuyi/dsh-balance-meter/releases/latest/download/zhujiuyi-dsh-balance-0.2.5.tgz
```

Installing from the repository works too:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhujiuyi/dsh-balance-meter
```

Uninstall:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @zhujiuyi/dsh-balance
```

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Using it：Mostly you don't do anything. Three ways in:

1. **Glance** — the readout is always on the stats row: money for API credit, a percentage for subscriptions.
2. **Click** — provider, billing mode, endpoint, last-read time, and every quota window with its own bar.
3. **Ask** — say "how much quota is left" and the agent calls the `balance_check` tool.

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · On getting the number right：**3. The trend chart uses real readings only.** That curve comes from reads that actually happened, not a hardcoded sample series. With fewer than two readings it says it's still collecting rather than drawing a fake history.

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · When it refreshes automatically：- **After each finished turn** — refreshed once
- **A background check every 15 seconds** — refreshes if policy allows
- **A reading older than 5 minutes** — forced refresh (configurable)
- **You click "Refresh now"** — always

Two limits keep it polite: a **minimum interval** (30s by default) and a **failure cooldown**. Nothing polls while the page is hidden.

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · OpenDesign users: one extra step：OpenDesign is the only provider whose **billing is not on the API gateway host**, and it needs a login first:

```sh
vela login          # or sign in through the OpenDesign desktop app
```

That writes a credential to `~/.amr/config.json`, which the plugin reads.

**Why this is required:** the `sk-amr-…` API key you configure in DSH is a *runtime* key for inference, and the vendor explicitly rejects it for billing reads. Balance can only be read with the control key that signing in produces.

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · OpenDesign users: one extra step：Signed out, the plugin tells you to run `vela login` — it never treats that gateway as an uncatalogued relay and starts probing it.

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Configuration：Plugins page → the `@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance` card: preferred route, auto-refresh on/off, minimum interval, and the refresh-after ceiling.

To pin a custom endpoint or credential variable for one route, edit the `balance-meter` row in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: balance-meter
  name: "@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance"
  config:
    primary: deepseek

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Configuration：Templates support `{origin}` (scheme + host) and `{base}` (the full baseURL). Prefer `{origin}` — it doesn't care whether your baseURL carries a path segment.

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Privacy：- **No `exec` permission, no subprocesses** — no shell, no curl.
- **Requests go only to the gateway you configured** — no third-party domains, no telemetry, no phone-home.
- **Keys are used for that gateway only** — read from DSH's credential store, put in a request header, never written to disk, logs, or the browser snapshot. The snapshot carries variable *names* only (there's a test asserting this).
- **Nothing else in DSH is modified** — only this plugin's own config row.

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · For developers：```sh
npm run verify   # static contract check + all tests
npm test         # 305 tests, no DSH install required
npm run check    # contract check only
```

Four layers, none needing DSH: pure logic (parsers, preset chain, cache/throttle), host integration (stubs for `@deepseek-ai/*`, running the real `apply()`), a static contract check, and **browser-half render tests** (real `client.js` loaded with a minimal React stub and rendered across its states).

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · For developers：That last layer earns its keep: a `useMemo` referencing a `const` declared below it is a runtime scope error — invisible to `node --check` and to the contract check, but it crashes the component and makes the readout disappear. That happened once.

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Verification status：Of the 9 providers, **only OpenCode Go and OpenDesign have been checked against real responses** and had their parsers corrected. The rest report "reachable but unparseable" with an excerpt if their shape differs from the docs — send that excerpt and it gets fixed.

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Differences from the reference implementation：This is the DSH port of [ccgui-plugin-balance-meter](https://github.com/zhujiuyi/ccgui-plugin-balance-meter) (a CC GUI plugin). Because DSH provides credentials and outbound HTTP natively, this version **needs no exec permission**:

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Differences from the reference implementation：| | CC GUI version | This plugin |
|---|---|---|
| Reading credentials | Parses each engine's config, needs `exec:curl` | `ctx.credentials` directly |
| Networking | Host requires pre-declared domains, hence `exec:curl` | Plain `fetch` in-process |
| Route detection | Sniffs gateway hostnames | `ctx.llm.listProviders()` + profile |
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · Introduction：**中文** | [English](README.md)

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 余额与余量 · dsh-balance-meter：> 一个装在 DeepSeek Harness 里的小插件：**随时告诉你现在用的这个模型，还剩多少额度。**

你不需要打开各家的控制台、不用自己算、也不会被一个过期的数字骗到 —— 如果真的查不到，它会直说是为什么。

点一下这个读数，展开完整面板：

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 它解决什么问题：用 API 或者订阅额度跑 agent，最怕两件事：

1. **跑到一半额度没了**，任务中断，才发现余额是 0。
2. **打开一堆控制台**去核对 —— DeepSeek 一个站、Kimi 一个站、智谱又一个站，而且各家说法还不一样：有的给钱数，有的给百分比。

这个插件把这件事收成一处：**当前会话在用哪个模型，它就查哪个模型对应的额度**，并且用同一种方式展示。

---
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 它能查什么：它是**按供应商**查的，不是按模型查的 —— 同一个供应商下的所有模型共用一份额度。

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ✅ 能查：内置 9 家：| 供应商 | 查什么 | 显示成 |
|---|---|---|
| **DeepSeek** | 账户余额 | 金额（如 `¥12.34`） |
| **OpenRouter** | 密钥额度 | 金额 |
| **Moonshot / Kimi** | 账户余额 | 金额 |
| **SiliconFlow** | 账户余额 | 金额 |
| **智谱 GLM / Z.AI** | 订阅额度 | 窗口百分比 |
| **Kimi Coding** | 订阅额度 | 窗口百分比 |
| **MiniMax** | 套餐余量 | 窗口百分比 |
| **OpenCode Go** | 订阅额度 | 窗口百分比 |
| **OpenDesign (AMR)** | 钱包 + Design Plan 窗口 | 金额 + 百分比 |

「窗口百分比」是指它会把**滚动 / 每周 / 每月**这类额度周期逐个列出来，各带进度条和重置时间。所以你能看出「是这个 5 小时的窗口快满了，还是这个月的总量见底了」。

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ⚠️ 可能能查：常见中转站：如果你用的是**自建中转站**（New-API、Sub2API、CloseAI、claude-code-hub 这类面板），插件会按一组常见接口自动试一遍：

```
/api/usage/token/  →  /v1/dashboard/billing/subscription  →  /v1/usage
→  /api/v1/me/quota  →  /dashboard/billing/credit_grants
→  /api/v1/credits  →  /api/user/self
```

哪个先返回可读数字就用哪个。**你在插件里填的自定义接口排在最前面**，优先于全部预设。

> 这套机制（顺序、短路、单位校准）有测试覆盖，但**各条预设的响应结构是从公开面板清单整理的，作者无法逐家实机验证**。所以认不出时会明确报「可连通·无法解析」并附上原始响应，而不是猜一个数字给你。

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · ❌ 不能查：这些情况：| 情况 | 会怎样 |
|---|---|
| **供应商没有公开余额接口** | 明确说「官方没有公开接口」，不编造 |
| **路由不在内置目录里，且中转站预设都没命中** | 报「未收录」，并附最后一次的原始响应 |
| **凭据没配** | 指出去配哪个环境变量 |
| **接口通了但结构不认识** | 报「无法解析」，附响应片段（已遮蔽密钥） |

「未收录」的意思是 **本插件还不认识这个供应商**，不等于它没有余额接口。这时用 `balance_set_endpoint` 填一条自定义接口就能解决。

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add @zhujiuyi/dsh-balance
```

装完**重启 DSH**，输入框下方的状态行就会出现读数。

> **别装 `dsh-balance-meter`**（不带作用域）。那个名字在 npm 上属于别人。

不想用 npm 的话，也可以直接装 Release 里的 tarball（路径里的 `/latest/` 会自动指向最新一版，不用手改版本号）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/zhujiuyi/dsh-balance-meter/releases/latest/download/zhujiuyi-dsh-balance-0.2.5.tgz
```

从仓库直接装也可以：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhujiuyi/dsh-balance-meter
```

卸载：

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 安装：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove @zhujiuyi/dsh-balance
```

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 怎么用：装好之后你基本什么都不用做。三种使用方式：

**1. 看一眼** —— 状态行的读数常驻，余额是钱数，订阅是百分比。

**2. 点开看详情** —— 供应商、计费方式、接口地址、最近读取时间；订阅渠道会逐个列出额度窗口。

**3. 问 agent** —— 直接说「还剩多少额度」，它会调 `balance_check` 工具去查。

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 关于「数字准不准」这件事：这是本插件最在意的一点。三条规则：

**① 绝不猜数字。** 查不到就报查不到，并说明原因。宁可显示「无法查询」，也不会给你一个看起来合理但是错的数。

**② 过期数字会标注。** 一次自动刷新失败、但之前成功读过时，读数继续显示上次的值，并标注「可能已过期」，失败原因写在详情里。不会把旧数字当成当前值。

**③ 趋势图只用真实读数。** 面板里那条曲线来自**实际发生过的读取**，不是画出来好看的示意线。读数不足两次时，它会说「正在累积读数」，而不是假装有一条历史曲线。
section: 关于「数字准不准」这件事

text:
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 什么时候会自动刷新：- **每轮对话结束后** —— 刷新一次
- **后台每 15 秒检查一次** —— 满足条件就刷新
- **读数超过 5 分钟没更新** —— 强制刷新一次（可在设置里改）
- **你点「立即刷新」** —— 无条件刷新

刷新受两个值约束：**最小间隔**（默认 30 秒，避免把供应商打爆）和**失败冷却**（出错后不立刻重试）。页面不可见时不会轮询。

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · OpenDesign 用户请注意：OpenDesign 是唯一一个**账单不在 API 网关主机上**的供应商，需要额外一步：

```sh
vela login          # 或在 OpenDesign 桌面端登录
```

登录后凭据会写到 `~/.amr/config.json`，插件自动读取。

**为什么必须这样**：DSH 里配的 `sk-amr-…` API Key 是**推理用**的 runtime key，官方明确规定它不能读账单。余额只能用它登录产生的另一个凭据（controlKey）来查。

没登录时插件会直接告诉你该跑 `vela login`，而不是把这个网关当成未收录的中转站乱试。

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 设置：插件页 → `@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance` 卡片：优先显示的路由、是否自动刷新、最小刷新间隔、超过多久自动刷新。

要给某个路由指定自定义接口或凭据变量名，编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `balance-meter` 那一行：

```yaml
- id: balance-meter
  name: "@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance"
  config:
    primary: deepseek

模板支持 `{origin}`（scheme + host）和 `{base}`（完整 baseURL）。用 `{origin}` 更稳，不受 baseURL 带没带路径段影响。

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 隐私：- **不申请 exec 权限，不启动子进程** —— 没有 shell、没有 curl。
- **只请求你自己配置的那个网关** —— 没有第三方域名、没有遥测、没有回传。
- **密钥只用于该网关** —— 从 DSH 凭据库读取，放进请求头，不落盘、不入日志、不进浏览器快照。快照里只有变量名，没有值（有测试断言）。
- **不写 DSH 的其他配置** —— 只改本插件自己那一行。

---

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 给开发者：```sh
npm run verify   # 静态契约检查 + 全部测试
npm test         # 305 个测试，不需要安装 DSH
npm run check    # 只跑静态契约检查
```

测试分四层，全部不依赖 DSH：纯逻辑（解析器、探测链、缓存节流）、宿主半集成（桩替代 `@deepseek-ai/*`，跑真实 `apply()`）、静态契约检查、以及**浏览器半的渲染测试**（真实加载 `client.js` 用最小 React 桩渲染各状态）。

最后那层是必要的：一个 `useMemo` 在 `const` 声明前引用了变量，属于运行时作用域错误 —— `node --check` 和契约检查都发现不了，但会让整个组件崩溃、入口消失。这个 bug 确实发生过一次。
@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 已知的实测状态：9 家中，**只有 OpenCode Go / OpenDesign 拿到过真实响应**并据此修正过解析。其余各家若结构与文档不符，会走「可连通·无法解析」并回显原始响应 —— 把回显发我即可修正。

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 与参考实现的差异：本插件是 [ccgui-plugin-balance-meter](https://github.com/zhujiuyi/ccgui-plugin-balance-meter)（CC GUI 版）的 DSH 移植。因为 DSH 原生提供凭据与 HTTP 出口，这一版**不需要 exec 权限**：

| | CC GUI 版 | 本插件 |
|---|---|---|
| 读凭据 | 自己解析各引擎配置，须 `exec:curl` | `ctx.credentials` 直接读 |
| 联网 | 宿主要求预声明域名，只能用 `exec:curl` | 进程内直接 `fetch` |
| 识别路由 | 嗅探网关域名 | `ctx.llm.listProviders()` + profile |

其他差异：界面在输入框下方状态行（`conversation.composer.dock`）而非状态栏；状态行显示的窗口**按跨度由短到长**取第一个有数字的（5 小时 → 每周 → 每月），因为那是最先会挡住你的那道闸。

@zhujiuyi/dsh-balance README · 与参考实现的差异：设计规格见 [docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-dsh-balance-meter-design.md](docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-dsh-balance-meter-design.md)。

---
